newsitem.title: USA: Sheldahl gets first production order for product.
newsitem.headline: Sheldahl gets first production order for product.

text.p: Sheldahl Inc said Wednesday it received the first production order for its proprietary Novaclad-based micro products technology.

The first order is from ASAT Inc of Palo Alto, Calif., a large integrated circuit chip packaging company, which will use Sheldahl's high-density substrate to create a 352 pin-count tape ball grid array chip package. Production of the chip-carrier substrate will begin immediately in Sheldahl's Longmont, Colo., micro products plant.
The size or value of the order was not given.

"ASAT's confidence in our company and technology serve to validate the strategic direction we embarked upon several years ago when we invented Novaclad and designed our one-of-a-kind production facility," James Donaghy, Sheldahl president, said in a statement.

Sheldahl makes high quality laminates, flexible printed circuitry, and high-density substrates, primarily for sale to the automotive electronics and datacommunications markets. ASAT Inc is the North American distributor for services of ASAT Ltd.
